entries.comparison: Static fixed-cardinality squared-error quantization; this paper credits the standard centroid and small-ball tools, not a new quantization theory.
entries.title: Foundations of Quantization for Probability Distributions

entries.comparison: The quadratic perspective is a standard convex construction. The experiment-level conditional identity uses it, rather than claiming perspective convexity anew.
entries.title: Convex Optimization

entries.comparison: Proper-score and entropy/Bregman connections are standard; the new decomposition is specialized to an actually executed finite observer and its raw likelihood.
entries.title: Strictly proper scoring rules, prediction, and estimation

entries.comparison: Sequential vector quantization of a stationary Markov source is cast as partially observed stochastic control and analyzed by dynamic programming. This is a direct methodological neighbor; our observer receives a raw report, not the hidden source point, and the converse is a hard-total-state terminal task bound.
entries.title: Optimal Sequential Vector Quantization of Markov Sources

entries.comparison: Finite-state vector quantization already uses state-selected codebooks and recursive next-state rules. We do not claim the finite-state coding architecture is new. The likelihood reweighting and merged-row conditional centroids are the specific comparison objects.
entries.title: Finite-state vector quantization for waveform coding

entries.comparison: Recursive marginal quantization controls error propagation for approximated Markov dynamics. Our common-cover upper is adjacent; the all-Borel converse, physical likelihood law and internal halt-state count are separate assertions.
entries.title: Recursive marginal quantization of the Euler scheme of a diffusion process

entries.comparison: Nonanticipative rate-distortion theory charges an information quantity on causal reconstruction laws, rather than every persistent label in one autonomous machine. No equivalence of those budgets is asserted.
entries.title: Information Nonanticipative Rate Distortion Function and Its Applications

entries.comparison: Finite-horizon causal filtering and nonanticipative distortion allocations are directly adjacent. The manuscript distinguishes directed-information or rate constraints from a total number of phase, update and halt labels.
entries.title: Optimal estimation via nonanticipative rate distortion function and applications to time-varying Gauss--Markov processes

entries.comparison: Gaussian sequential rate-distortion has semidefinite formulations. Our Gaussian realization is a finite hidden-state model with continuous Gaussian likelihoods, not a replacement for Gaussian-source rate-distortion results.
entries.source_type: author preprint; published IEEE TAC DOI 10.1109/TAC.2016.2601148
entries.title: Semidefinite programming approach to Gaussian sequential rate-distortion trade-offs

entries.comparison: Projective/cone contraction is an established filter-stability method. The manuscript supplies elementary estimates and combines them with actual row mass and a counted finite observer; stability alone is not claimed new.
entries.title: Exponential stability for nonlinear filtering

entries.comparison: Finite-window feedback approximation and POMDP control are established. Our passive fixed-protocol theorem does not supersede adaptive feedback optimality or turn a counted-label budget into a window-length budget.
entries.title: Near Optimality of Finite Memory Feedback Policies in Partially Observed Markov Decision Processes

entries.comparison: The published 2022 article, not merely its preprint, is cited. Its stationary/finite-memory zero-delay coding conclusions have different observations, horizon and resource variables.
entries.title: Zero-delay lossy coding of linear vector Markov sources: optimality of stationary codes and near optimality of finite memory codes

entries.comparison: The static uniform-circle coefficient is credited to existing exact quantization work. The retained recursive product and internal deadline law are separate inherited results, not new static geometry.
entries.source_type: author institutional archive linking published DOI 10.4134/CKMS.c210434
entries.title: Uniform distributions on curves and quantization

scope: Targeted primary-source publication and theorem-interface comparison. Not an exhaustive priority search or a fresh full-proof certification of every cited paper. Published versions used where verified.
